rule: Steep fall instead of RSI: SPY 10% below its 10-day high
Steep fall instead of RSI: SPY 10% below its 20-day high
Steep fall instead of RSI: SPY 15% below its 20-day high
Steep fall instead of RSI: SPY 20% below its 40-day high
RSI 25 or steep fall: SPY 10% below its 10-day high
RSI 25 or steep fall: SPY 15% below its 20-day high
VIX spike instead of RSI: VIX peaked 30+ and is 10% off its peak
VIX spike instead of RSI: VIX peaked 35+ and is 15% off its peak
VIX spike instead of RSI: VIX peaked 40+ and is 15% off its peak
RSI 25 or VIX spike (35+, 15% off peak)
